notes.title: She Doesn't Walk - Gameplay Update
notes.content:
Thank you to all who've purchased (and kept) She Doesn't Walk!

I've seen several comments written about the camera being locked, the player can't turn around 360 degrees. This isn't a bug or a problem, it's a gameplay mechanic. 

In the description, you read about how "you're too scared to turn around."

From the beginning, before I even started designing the game, I had this in mind and It's for a reason fundamental to the game and its unique features.

When walking down the corridor and you see the feet dragging, it adds to the psychological fear that the player has. It was my intention for the player to never know just how close she is in order to keep it scary. If the player had the ability to turn around and look down the hallway to see how close she is, it would break the illusion of her being even closer. It would possibly even make the camera switching mechanic gratuitous.

That said, perhaps I can do an update in the future to where the player's camera only does the "lock" in certain areas of the game. Maybe the first room would be a 360-degree camera and some places outside. If this is an update you'd enjoy trying, let me know and I'll make it happen soon.

Thanks again!

David

notes.title: She Doesn't Walk - Patch 01
notes.content:
Thank you to all who've purchased (and kept) She Doesn't Walk!
I'm releasing my first patch and it should be live sometime within the next 24 hours. 
Below are some of the things I've updated.

David

Update Notes - V2
01/23/2021

Bugs fixed
- Start screen clickable only once.
- Fixed lantern icon. Icon lit up when clicking the dropped lantern.
- Door ignores boxes now.
- Normals issue on bird's nest fixed.
- Fixed capsule collision and navmesh issues for "Her", no more landscape clipping.
 
Gameplay improvements
- Made step ladder non-interactive to encourage other exploration.
- Slowed the auto turning a touch.
- Brightened the environment just a little. 
- Strengthened Lights on interactable objects things (planks, bricks, etc.) 
- Removed the need for the bolt cutters a second time.
- Improved the functionality of the plank, the player can no longer "surf".
- Improved grass footstep sound effect, removed the "popping."

notes.title: She Doesn't Walk - Release Date
notes.content:
She Doesn't Walk, will have its initial release on the 21st.
Remember to wishlist!

She doesn't walk is a short, one-button game (aside from ASWD), survival/horror game that is a complete adventure designed to be replayed time and again, with friends.
